defects.title: ErrorEvent acknowledge/resolve audit record not tested; admin session success path not verified
defects.invariant: Every state-changing management endpoint must have audit record verified by test; admin authorization path must be tested
defects.mechanism: ErrorEventEndpointsTests.cs:46-133 tests List, AcknowledgeAsync, ResolveAsync, GetAsync, filter injection, pagination, performance, and 401/403 rejection for non-manager sessions. However: (1) No test verifies that audit.AppendAsync is called with correct parameters (AggregateId=fingerprint, actorId, afterStateJson) after AcknowledgeAsync or ResolveAsync. The audit call in ChangeAsync (lines 196-201) uses Guid.NewGuid() for AggregateId (defect F0757) and is not asserted in any test. (2) The test CallWithoutAManagerSessionIsRejected (lines 117-132) only verifies 401/403 for non-manager; there is no test that a valid manager session (with ObservabilityEndpoints.ManagePermission) successfully completes acknowledge/resolve and returns 204. The authorization check at line 192 uses authorization.AuthorizeAsync but no test exercises the success path with a properly authorized principal.
defects.acceptance: Add tests verifying: (a) audit.AppendAsync is invoked with correct AuditEvent (AggregateId = fingerprint, actorId = manager, action = monitoring.error.acknowledged/resolved) after successful acknowledge/resolve; (b) a request with valid manager session/permission succeeds (204) and changes error event status. Mock or use real IAuditEventStore to capture and assert the audit call.

limitations: The IAuditEventStore interface is used directly in endpoints; tests would need to either mock it (via DI override) or use a capturing implementation. The current test infrastructure uses PgTestDatabase for DB but the audit store may write to a different table/schema. The authorization check uses IAuthorizationService with ObservabilityEndpoints.ManagePermission - tests need to construct a principal with this permission or mock the authorization service.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
